confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator estimates (citycost.org, 12go.com, Numbeo-derived city averages) and a few undated venue menus, so they are moderate quality. Beer is a bounded estimate between those sources and the higher hotel-restaurant menus. Cocktail and wine are weaker and were set relative to beer (about 1.4x for cocktail; house wine priced below a cocktail). Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against live listings. Yen figures were converted at roughly 160 JPY per USD. FX: I could not confirm the RBA observation as the latest for 2026-10-16. The 0.7088 figure dated 2026-03-20 came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct read of the official table, and it may be several months old.
comparable_city_reasoning: Toyama-specific aggregator figures (citycost.org and 12go.com), adjusted with Tokyo-relative cost ratios. Drink levels come from national venue menus, adjusted down for a regional city. Comparable to other mid-sized Japanese regional cities such as Niigata and Kitakyushu for restaurant and coffee prices.
